11 / Methodology
SOURCES / LIMITS

Sources, definitions and limitations

Every procurement record follows as its own slide: this is the underlying evidence, not merely ten selected examples.

One lot
A canonical legal procurement lot; several physical devices within one lot do not become several lots.
Price types
NMC ≠ bid ≠ registered contract ≠ payment. EPC and design budgets are not hardware-only value.
Suppliers
A bidder named in a protocol cannot automatically be named a signed supplier or manufacturer.
Sources
Original source URLs appear where stored in the database. Unverified fields are explicitly labeled.
